title: A Bernstein problem for translating solutions to the mean curvature flow
summary:
We study entire graphical translating solutions of the mean curvature flow, \[ \operatorname{div}\!\left( rac{
abla G}{\sqrt{1+|
abla G|^2}}ight) = rac{1}{\sqrt{1+|
abla G|^2}} \qquad	ext{in }\mathbb R^N. \] Every such graph is mean-convex, since its mean curvature is the vertical component of its unit normal. In dimension two, mean-convex translating solitons are convex, and an entire graphical translator is therefore the rotationally symmetric bowl soliton.
